images.description: A batch of images as a 4D tensor or NumPy array. Shape should be (batch_size, height, width, channels).

segmentation_masks.description: A batch of segmentation masks as a 3D or 4D tensor or NumPy array. Shape should be (batch_size, height, width) or (batch_size, height, width, 1). The values represent class indices starting from 1 up to `num_classes`. Class 0 is reserved for the background and will be ignored if `ignore_index` is not 0.

num_classes.description: The number of segmentation classes. If `None`, it is inferred from the maximum value in `segmentation_masks`.

color_mapping.description: A dictionary mapping class indices to RGB colors. If `None`, a default color palette is generated. The keys should be integers starting from 1 up to `num_classes`.

alpha.description: The opacity of the segmentation masks. Must be in the range `[0, 1]`.

blend.description: Whether to blend the masks with the input image using the `alpha` value. If `False`, the masks are drawn directly on the images without blending. Defaults to `True`.
constraints: blend must be one of False, True

ignore_index.description: The class index to ignore. Mask pixels with this value will not be drawn. Defaults to -1.

data_format.description: Image data format, either `"channels_last"` or `"channels_first"`. Defaults to the `image_data_format` value found in your Keras config file at `~/.keras/keras.json`. If you never set it, then it will be `"channels_last"`.
constraints: data_format must be one of channels_last, channels_first, image_data_format

output.description: A NumPy array of the images with the segmentation masks overlaid.
